zh: 杯中加入百利甜。
加入阿萨姆茉莉奶绿，轻轻搅匀后饮用。
en: Add Baileys to the glass.
Pour in the Assam jasmine milk tea and stir gently.

description.zh: 奶香与茶香交叠，像雪夜里的一盏暖灯。
description.en: Creamy, tea-forward and comforting—like a warm light on a snowy night.

recipes.sourceText: 百利甜30+阿萨姆茉莉奶绿90

zh: 杯中装入冰块并加入白兰地。
用可乐补满，轻轻搅拌。
en: Fill the glass with ice and add brandy.
Top with cola and stir gently.

description.zh: 直接、浓郁，适合想要快速完成的一杯。
description.en: A direct, rich highball for an effortless home pour.

recipes.sourceText: 白兰地50+可乐补满

zh: 加入白兰地与冰块。
倒入水溶C青桔，轻轻搅匀。
en: Add brandy and ice.
Pour in Water-C green kumquat and stir gently.

description.zh: 青桔的清亮酸香，让白兰地更轻快。
description.en: Bright kumquat acidity gives brandy a lighter, fresher profile.

recipes.sourceText: 白兰地35+水溶C青桔100

zh: 杯中加入野格和冰块。
倒入葡萄汁并搅匀。
en: Add Jägermeister and ice to the glass.
Pour in grape juice and stir.

description.zh: 不是传统番茄版，而是野格与葡萄汁构成的破晓原创版本。
description.en: A Dawn's Dew original—Jägermeister and grape juice rather than the classic tomato profile.

recipes.sourceText: 野格30+葡萄汁90

zh: 杯中装满冰块，加入白朗姆。
加入橙汁至约八分满。
用葡萄味汽水补满，轻轻提拉混合。
en: Fill the glass with ice and add white rum.
Pour orange juice to roughly eight-tenths full.
Top with grape soda and lift gently to mix.

description.zh: 橙色落日与紫色气泡相遇，是一杯有速度感的果香高球。
description.en: Orange sunset meets purple fizz in a fast, fruit-forward highball.

recipes.sourceText: 橙汁八分，白朗姆50，葡萄味汽水补满

zh: 杯中加入满冰和白朗姆。
加入水溶C西柚至八分满。
用芬达茉莉蜜桃补满。
en: Add a full glass of ice and white rum.
Pour Water-C grapefruit to eight-tenths full.
Top with jasmine peach Fanta.

description.zh: 西柚的微苦与蜜桃茉莉气泡交织，呈现清透天空感。
description.en: Grapefruit bitterness and peach-jasmine fizz create a clear, sky-like finish.

recipes.sourceText: 白朗姆30ml，水溶C西柚八分，茉莉蜜桃芬达补满

zh: 杯中加入冰块与白朗姆。
加入水溶C柠檬至六分满。
用葡萄味汽水补满。
en: Add ice and white rum.
Pour Water-C lemon to six-tenths full.
Top with grape soda.

description.zh: 酸甜轻盈，紫色气泡带来初次心动般的明快。
description.en: Lightly sweet and tart, with purple fizz and a first-flutter brightness.

recipes.sourceText: 水溶C柠檬六分，白朗姆30ml，葡萄味气泡补满

zh: 杯中加入冰块和水溶C青皮橘至八分满。
将白朗姆与莓莓桃桃加冰摇匀。
把摇匀后的酒液加入杯中，形成晚霞层次。
en: Add ice and Water-C green orange to eight-tenths full.
Shake white rum and berry peach drink with ice.
Pour the shaken mixture into the glass for a layered sunset effect.

description.zh: 橘色基底与莓桃色泽交叠，像天边缓慢铺开的晚霞。
description.en: Orange citrus and berry-peach tones layer like a slowly spreading evening sky.

recipes.sourceText: 水溶C青皮橘八分，白朗姆30ml莓莓桃桃60 shake加入

zh: 杯中加满冰块，加入白朗姆和橙汁。
按口味挤入少量柠檬汁。
用气泡水补满并轻搅。
en: Fill the glass with ice, then add white rum and orange juice.
Add a little lemon juice to taste.
Top with soda water and stir gently.

description.zh: 明亮柑橘与气泡感，像加州午后的阳光。
description.en: Bright citrus and bubbles with the warmth of a California afternoon.

recipes.sourceText: 橙汁90，白朗姆45，柠檬，气泡水补满

zh: 杯中加满冰块，倒入白朗姆和青柠汁。
加入可乐，轻轻搅拌。
en: Fill the glass with ice and add white rum and lime juice.
Add cola and stir gently.

description.zh: 更明确的青柠比例，让经典组合更鲜明。
description.en: A lime-forward personal take on the familiar rum-and-cola classic.

recipes.sourceText: 可乐180，青柠15，白朗姆50

zh: 杯中加入冰块、白朗姆和蓝橙力娇酒。
加入水溶C血橙至八分满，轻轻搅匀。
en: Add ice, white rum and blue curaçao.
Pour Water-C blood orange to eight-tenths full and stir gently.

description.zh: 蓝橙与血橙在杯中交错，色彩醒目、果香直接。
description.en: Blue curaçao and blood orange collide in a vivid, fruit-forward pour.

recipes.sourceText: 白朗姆30，蓝橙15，水溶C血橙八分

zh: 加入白朗姆、伏特加和冰块。
依次加入芬达茉莉蜜桃、雪碧与水溶C血橙。
轻轻搅匀后饮用。
en: Add white rum, vodka and ice.
Pour in jasmine peach Fanta, Sprite and Water-C blood orange.
Stir gently.

description.zh: 多种果味与双基酒交织，入口轻快但酒体不可低估。
description.en: Layered fruit flavors hide a dual-spirit base—bright, but not lightweight.

recipes.sourceText: 白朗姆15，伏特加15，芬达茉莉蜜桃+雪碧+水溶C血橙各30

zh: 杯中加入冰块、白朗姆和蓝橙力娇酒。
加入椰汁至八分满并轻轻搅匀。
en: Add ice, white rum and blue curaçao.
Pour coconut drink to eight-tenths full and stir gently.

description.zh: 蓝色热带感与柔和椰香结合，暂时保留它的未命名状态。
description.en: A blue tropical pour softened by coconut, deliberately left untitled for now.

recipes.sourceText: 椰汁八分，蓝橙15+白朗姆30

zh: 杯中加冰并倒入伏特加。
加入橙汁，再用葡萄味汽水补满。
轻轻提拉一次，让颜色自然交融。
en: Add ice and vodka.
Pour in orange juice and top with grape soda.
Lift once gently to let the colors meet naturally.

description.zh: 橙紫渐变鲜明，是个人评级最高的一杯之一。
description.en: A vivid orange-to-purple gradient and one of the highest-rated personal pours.

recipes.sourceText: 伏特加30，橙汁60，葡萄味汽水补满

zh: 杯中加入冰块和伏特加。
加入水溶C柠檬至六分满。
用青苹果美年达补满。
en: Add ice and vodka.
Pour Water-C lemon to six-tenths full.
Top with green apple Mirinda.

description.zh: 柠檬与青苹果形成清脆明亮的绿色果香。
description.en: Lemon and green apple create a crisp, bright green-fruit profile.

recipes.sourceText: 伏特加30ml，水溶C柠檬六分，青苹果美年达补满

zh: 杯中加入伏特加与一瓶养乐多。
加入葡萄汁至八分满。
充分搅匀，按需加冰。
en: Add vodka and one bottle of Yakult.
Pour grape juice to eight-tenths full.
Mix thoroughly and add ice if desired.

description.zh: 乳酸甜感与葡萄果味组成一杯颜色浓郁的便利店魔法。
description.en: A convenience-store spell of tangy cultured milk and rich grape fruitiness.

recipes.sourceText: 养乐多一瓶，葡萄汁八分，伏特加45ml

zh: 加入伏特加、益力多和莓莓桃桃。
加冰后充分搅匀，或短暂摇和后倒入杯中。
en: Combine vodka, Yakult and berry peach drink.
Stir well over ice, or shake briefly and strain into the glass.

description.zh: 桃香、莓果和乳酸甜感，柔和讨喜。
description.en: Peach, berry and cultured-milk sweetness in a soft, crowd-friendly mix.

recipes.sourceText: 益力多100，莓桃汁50，伏特加30

zh: 杯中加入伏特加、椰汁与葡萄汁。
加入冰块并充分搅匀。
en: Combine vodka, coconut drink and grape juice.
Add ice and mix thoroughly.

description.zh: 椰香柔化葡萄的深色果味，口感饱满。
description.en: Coconut softens deep grape fruit, creating a round and full-bodied drink.

recipes.sourceText: 伏特加30，椰汁100，葡萄汁100

zh: 杯中加冰并倒入伏特加。
加入葡萄味汽水与水溶C西柚，轻轻搅匀。
en: Add ice and vodka.
Pour in grape soda and Water-C grapefruit, then stir gently.

description.zh: 葡萄的甜与西柚的微苦，像想念里并存的甜涩。
description.en: Sweet grape and bittersweet grapefruit echo the mixed edges of longing.

recipes.sourceText: 伏特加30，葡萄味汽水100，水溶C西柚50

zh: 杯中加入伏特加与冰块。
加入葡萄汁和水溶C柠檬，搅匀。
en: Add vodka and ice.
Pour in grape juice and Water-C lemon, then stir.

description.zh: 葡萄的浓甜被柠檬酸感紧紧收住，轮廓清晰。
description.en: Rich grape sweetness is held tightly by lemon acidity for a sharply defined profile.

recipes.sourceText: 伏特加30，葡萄汁50，水溶C柠檬100

zh: 杯中放入六颗葡萄冰。
加入伏特加与水溶C柠檬，轻轻搅动。
en: Place six frozen grapes in the glass.
Add vodka and Water-C lemon, then stir gently.

description.zh: 葡萄冰代替普通冰块，随着融化逐渐增加果味。
description.en: Frozen grapes replace ordinary ice, slowly deepening the fruit character as they soften.

recipes.sourceText: 伏特加30，葡萄冰6颗，水溶C柠檬100

zh: 杯中加入冰块和伏特加。
加入橙汁与椰子水，轻轻搅匀。
en: Add ice and vodka.
Pour in orange juice and coconut water, then stir gently.

description.zh: 橙香与椰子水清爽融合，像阳光落在海面。
description.en: Orange and coconut water meet in a light, sunlit seaside profile.

recipes.sourceText: 橙汁60，椰子水60，伏特加30

zh: 杯中加入冰块与伏特加。
加入莓莓桃桃至五分满。
用蜜桃气泡水补满。
en: Add ice and vodka.
Pour berry peach drink to halfway.
Top with peach sparkling water.

description.zh: 轻柔莓桃果香配上细密气泡，是一杯没有压力的心动。
description.en: Soft berry-peach fruit and fine bubbles make an easygoing first flutter.

recipes.sourceText: 伏特加30，莓莓桃桃五分，蜜桃气泡水补满

zh: 杯中加满冰块，倒入伏特加和蓝橙力娇酒。
用气泡水补满，轻轻搅匀。
en: Fill the glass with ice and add vodka and blue curaçao.
Top with soda water and stir gently.

description.zh: 蓝色酒液、清透气泡与克制甜度，带着冷静的海岸感。
description.en: Blue spirit, clear bubbles and restrained sweetness evoke a cool, quiet coast.

recipes.sourceText: 伏特加30，蓝橙25，气泡水补满

zh: 杯中加入冰块、伏特加、蓝橙力娇酒和葡萄汁。
加入雪碧至八分满，轻轻搅匀。
en: Add ice, vodka, blue curaçao and grape juice.
Pour Sprite to eight-tenths full and stir gently.

description.zh: 颜色迷人、甜味易饮，但双重酒基需要慢饮。
description.en: Visually inviting and easy to sip, but its dual alcoholic base deserves a slower pace.

recipes.sourceText: 伏特加30+蓝橙30+葡萄汁15+雪碧八分

zh: 轻拍薄荷后放入杯中，加入青柠汁与糖浆。
加入白朗姆和碎冰，搅匀后用气泡水补满。
en: Gently clap the mint and add it with lime juice and syrup.
Add white rum and crushed ice, stir, then top with soda water.

description.zh: 薄荷、青柠与朗姆构成清爽明亮的经典长饮。
description.en: Mint, lime and rum form a bright, refreshing classic long drink.

zh: 所有材料加入装冰的摇酒壶。
充分摇匀后滤入冰镇杯中。
en: Add all ingredients to an ice-filled shaker.
Shake well and strain into a chilled glass.

description.zh: 结构简洁，却能清楚展现朗姆、酸度与甜度的平衡。
description.en: A concise balance of rum, acidity and sweetness.

zh: 可选：用青柠湿润杯口并蘸盐。
其余材料加冰摇匀，滤入杯中。
en: Optional: moisten the rim with lime and coat it with salt.
Shake the remaining ingredients with ice and strain.

description.zh: 龙舌兰、橙香与青柠组成鲜明有力的酸甜骨架。
description.en: Tequila, orange and lime create a vivid, assertive sour profile.

zh: 可选蛋清与其余材料先无冰摇匀。
加入冰块再次摇匀，滤入装冰杯中。
en: If using egg white, dry-shake it with the other ingredients first.
Add ice, shake again, and strain over fresh ice.

description.zh: 酸甜柔化威士忌棱角，可选蛋清带来绵密口感。
description.en: Sweet and sour soften the whiskey; optional egg white adds a silky texture.

zh: 杯中放入方糖和苦精，压碎混合。
加入大冰块与波本，缓慢搅拌，可用橙片装饰。
en: Muddle the sugar cube with bitters in the glass.
Add a large ice cube and bourbon, stir slowly, and optionally garnish with orange.

description.zh: 用糖与苦精轻微修饰威士忌本身，是经典短饮。
description.en: Sugar and bitters lightly frame the whiskey in this classic short drink.

zh: 所有酒液加入装冰的杯中。
充分搅拌，可用橙片装饰。
en: Add all liquid ingredients to an ice-filled glass.
Stir well and optionally garnish with orange.

description.zh: 等比例带来浓郁苦甜、草本和柑橘层次。
description.en: Equal parts deliver a bold bittersweet, herbal and citrus profile.

zh: 杯中装满冰块并加入金酒。
沿杯壁加入汤力水，轻搅，可用青柠装饰。
en: Fill the glass with ice and add gin.
Pour in tonic water, stir gently, and optionally garnish with lime.

description.zh: 清爽、微苦且香气突出，是容易上手的经典高球。
description.en: Crisp, lightly bitter and aromatic—an approachable classic highball.

zh: 金酒与干味美思加冰搅拌至充分冰镇。
滤入冰镇杯中，可用橄榄装饰。
en: Stir gin and dry vermouth with ice until thoroughly chilled.
Strain into a chilled glass and optionally garnish with an olive.

description.zh: 干爽、利落，以冰镇和稀释控制决定完成度。
description.en: Dry and precise, with chilling and dilution defining the result.

zh: 杯中装冰，加入伏特加与青柠汁。
加入姜汁啤酒并轻轻搅匀。
en: Fill the glass with ice and add vodka and lime juice.
Add ginger beer and stir gently.

description.zh: 青柠的酸与姜的辛香让伏特加高球更有轮廓。
description.en: Lime acidity and ginger spice give this vodka highball a clear edge.

zh: 杯中加冰，加入龙舌兰与橙汁。
沿杯壁缓慢加入糖浆，保留自然渐层。
en: Add ice, tequila and orange juice to the glass.
Slowly pour syrup down the side to preserve a sunrise gradient.

description.zh: 橙汁与渐层色彩带来直观的日出意象。
description.en: Orange juice and a natural gradient create an immediate sunrise image.

zh: 所有材料与冰块加入摇酒壶或搅拌机。
摇匀或搅打后倒入杯中。
en: Add all ingredients and ice to a shaker or blender.
Shake or blend, then pour into the glass.

description.zh: 菠萝与椰香浓郁柔滑，带有明确的热带气息。
description.en: Pineapple and coconut create a rich, smooth tropical profile.

zh: 所有材料加冰充分摇匀。
滤入冰镇杯中。
en: Shake all ingredients thoroughly with ice.
Strain into a chilled glass.

description.zh: 蔓越莓色泽明亮，酸甜与橙香包裹伏特加。
description.en: Bright cranberry color, tart fruit and orange wrap around vodka.

zh: 杯中加冰，加入伏特加与咖啡力娇酒。
缓慢加入淡奶油，饮用前按喜好搅匀。
en: Add ice, vodka and coffee liqueur to the glass.
Float in cream and stir to your preference before drinking.

description.zh: 咖啡、奶油与伏特加构成浓郁顺滑的餐后风格。
description.en: Coffee, cream and vodka make a rich, smooth after-dinner drink.

zh: 所有材料加冰搅拌至冰镇。
滤入冰镇杯中。
en: Stir all ingredients with ice until chilled.
Strain into a chilled glass.

description.zh: 威士忌与甜味美思形成厚实、香料感明显的经典结构。
description.en: Whiskey and sweet vermouth form a robust, spice-led classic.

zh: 所有材料加冰充分摇匀。
滤入冰镇杯中。
en: Shake all ingredients thoroughly with ice.
Strain into a chilled glass.

description.zh: 白兰地的圆润与橙香、柠檬酸度形成清晰对比。
description.en: Rounded brandy contrasts cleanly with orange and lemon acidity.

zh: 杯中装满冰块，加入威士忌。
用冰镇气泡水补满，轻搅，可挤入少量柠檬。
en: Fill the glass with ice and add whiskey.
Top with chilled soda water, stir gently, and optionally squeeze in lemon.

description.zh: 只需常见气泡水即可完成的清爽威士忌长饮。
description.en: A refreshing whiskey long drink made with widely available soda water.

zh: 杯中装冰并加入伏特加。
加入青苹果美年达，可选少量柠檬汁，轻搅。
en: Add ice and vodka to the glass.
Pour in green apple soda, optionally add lemon juice, and stir gently.

description.zh: 青苹果汽水让伏特加变得直观、轻松，适合聚会快速制作。
description.en: Green apple soda makes vodka bright, simple and party-friendly.

zh: 杯中加入冰块和百利甜。
倒入奶茶并轻轻搅匀。
en: Add ice and Baileys to the glass.
Pour in milk tea and stir gently.

description.zh: 便利店奶茶与百利甜组成柔滑、低门槛的甜口组合。
description.en: Convenience-store milk tea and Baileys make a smooth, approachable sweet serve.

zh: 杯中加满冰块并加入白朗姆。
加入西柚饮料，用气泡水补满。
en: Fill the glass with ice and add white rum.
Add grapefruit drink and top with soda water.

description.zh: 西柚的酸苦与轻盈气泡适合家庭随手调制。
description.en: Grapefruit's tart bitterness and light bubbles suit an easy home mix.

zh: 杯中装冰，加入白朗姆和椰子水。
用雪碧补满，可选加入青柠汁，轻搅。
en: Add ice, white rum and coconut water to the glass.
Top with Sprite, optionally add lime juice, and stir gently.

description.zh: 椰子水让朗姆更清透，少量汽水提供轻快甜感。
description.en: Coconut water keeps rum light while a little soda adds an easy sweetness.
